title: The dripping tap

data.source: Mass-on-spring dripping tap model after Shaw (1984) and Martien et al. (1985); our parameter values; no noise

prediction: A seed that averages past waits predicts the next wait better than "same as last time" and the long-run mean, and within a factor of two of the return map, in all three dripping regimes.
baseline: Persistence, the long-run mean, and the nonlinear return map built from the most similar past waits.
why: The averaged seed beats the simple guesses, but once the dripping is not a plain alternation it is far worse than the return map: the tap remembers one drop back through a curved rule, and an average of the past cannot follow a curve.
